name: DTF Transfer, Press Iron-On
descriptionHtml:
Transform your fabric projects effortlessly with the DTF Transfer Press Iron-On, perfect for personalizing apparel, home decor, and more. Designed for both beginners and professionals, these transfers offer bold colors and a smooth application that lasts through countless washes.

Product Highlights

  • Premium Quality: Features vibrant, bold colors that remain fresh and vibrant even after multiple washes.
  • Easy Application: Seamless adhesion using a heat press or iron, making it beginner-friendly and efficient.
  • Custom Sizes: Available in sizes ranging from 1 inch to 22 inches, tailored to suit any project.
  • Creative Freedom: Offers a wide variety of designs, graphics, and text options for personalization.

How to Apply a DTF Transfer

Using a Heat Press

  1. Clean and smooth the garment.
  2. Set the press to 310–325°F for 10–15 seconds.
  3. Place the DTF transfer and cover it with parchment paper.
  4. Press for 10–15 seconds.
  5. Allow the transfer to cool completely, then peel off the backing.
  6. Cover with parchment paper and press again for 5–10 seconds to secure the design.

Using an Iron

  1. Prep the garment by cleaning and smoothing out wrinkles.
  2. Set the iron to the highest cotton setting (350–375°F).
  3. Place the transfer and cover with parchment paper.
  4. Apply firm pressure with the iron for 10–15 seconds.
  5. Let cool slightly, peel off the backing, and iron again with parchment paper for 5–10 seconds.

Production & Shipping Information

  • Production Time: 1–2 business days.
  • Shipping: Standard delivery in 1–5 business days after production, with expedited options available.

Care Instructions

  • Wash inside out in cold water with similar colors.
  • Tumble dry on low heat.
  • Avoid ironing directly on the design to maintain its longevity.

Personalize your projects effortlessly with the DTF Transfer Press Iron-On—bold, vibrant, and made to last!

Elevate your footwear game with these versatile Clog Sandals, designed to suit your every need. Whether you prefer the classic sandal look or an easy flip-flop style, these shoes adapt effortlessly to your preferences.

  • Quick-Drying Convenience: Perfect for any weather, the quick-drying feature keeps your feet fresh, dry, and cool no matter the activity.
  • Indoor & Outdoor Ready: From casual strolls to beach outings, these sandals are suitable for any occasion, ensuring both style and practicality.

Additional Details:

  • Production Time: Approximately 3-5 business days.
  • Delivery Time: Standard shipping takes 7-10 business days. Expedited options are available at checkout.
  • Available Sizes: US sizes 5-12 (EU 36-46).
  • Care Instructions: Clean with a damp cloth and air dry.

With a perfect blend of comfort, functionality, and style, these Clog Sandals are the ideal choice for your everyday adventures.
